Fresh seafood, wide menu choice
Mar 2019 • Couples
We stopped here for dinner as I really fancied trying some local seafood, I wasn't disappointed.
The staff were friendly, helped talk us through the menu and advised us about which live catch options were available.

I had never tried oysters, so ordered a couple and also chose the fresh squid grilled with chilli, which was excellent. My husband isn't so much into seafood, so after crab soup to start he was pleased to have a number of pork and beef options on the menu to choose from for his main.

The service style is simple, but the food is all really tasty and the staff looked after us well.
When we asked for the bill we were presented with a plate of fresh fruit and desserts, which was a nice surprise.

If you are looking for a truly local experience then look no further. This place serves excellent seafood and the ambience cannot be any more local: Attended by large families and large groups of friends or colleagues. Both types of groups are extremely loud, both throw their cans and food remnants under the table on the floor and the latter group gets louder and louder as the evening progresses and they get more and more drunk. If you are looking for a pleasant place to spend a quiet evening, then better look for another place as this one has no charm whatsoever.

Great seafood
Jul 2017 • Friends
We found this place on LP/TA and decided to give it a try, as the (prepaid) food in our hotel was not very interesting, to be diplomatic. And we were not disappointed. The first evening was great, we ate grilled shrimp, beef salat, cobia, grouper and toadfish - all very fresh and delicious and you can choose the fish yourself. The cold beer was the perfect accompaniment. 

By Vietnamese standards the restaurant is not cheap, as far as I can judge, but well worth the price.

As a matter of fact it was so good that we returned the next day with a few colleagues - and again a great experience, but unfortunately they forgot one dish which finally arrived when most people in the group wanted to go home. Also this time the beer was warm. Staff was attentive despite the mishap, and we had a great time.

Eva
